messages.subject: [GGIR 1.5-10] Part 5 error : Error in aggregate.data.frame
parts:
Hello,

First of all, thanks for this tool box which is very useful for our project.

I have some problems since I am using the latest version of the GGIR (1.5-10 with R 3.4). I didn't have any problem when i was using the older version of GGIR 1.2-2 (which was installed automatically when i was using R 3.1). As I was interested by the part 5 report I installed the R 3.4 and a newest version of the GGIR. Since, but only for one of my participant (out of 10) I have the following error message :

''Report part 5
 loading all the milestone data from part 5 this can take a few minutes
 generating output for every parameter configurations...
 WW-30-100-400-T5A5
Error in aggregate.data.frame(A, by = list(A$filename), FUN = df) : 
  no rows to aggregate''

Anyone has already had this kind of error ? 

Best regards

Thanks for reporting this Alexandre - I have not encountered this issue so far.
Can you please also report it here: https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/issues
and elaborate on the context and what you have already tried to fix it yourself.

Thanks, Vincent
